title: RCF sub-OQ 1: F[X]-module structure (finite + torsion) on K^n via M

problemStatement.plain: First sub-OQ of the rational-canonical-form decomposition (parent minpoly-charpoly-oq-03): equip K^n with its F[X]-module structure via the M-action (the 'xModule'), and show it is finitely generated and torsion (Cayley-Hamilton). The file additionally carries the OQ-03-OQ-02 bridge statement xModule_has_invariantFactorChain as a sorry-guarded stub.
whyMatters: The finite + torsion module is the input to Mathlib's PID structure theorem, which drives the entire RCF existence proof.
Closes one of four sub-OQs decomposing the parent RCF capstone.
